candidatesRejected.title: Status bar counts a standalone punctuation token ('/') as a word
candidatesRejected.rationale: Control: body 'A / B' -> status '3 words' ([A][/][B] whitespace tokens). Microsoft Word's word counter is whitespace-token based and also counts standalone punctuation separated by spaces (documented Word behavior); Google Docs differs but this app models Word. No documented contract in the register covers punctuation-only tokens (B287 is source-mode fenced-code specific). Not a defect.
